variables.name: SmartscapeId
variables.input:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| fieldsKeep id

variables.name: AccountId
variables.input:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| fields aws.account.id
| dedup aws.account.id
| sort aws.account.id

variables.name: Region
variables.input:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| fields aws.region
| dedup aws.region
| sort aws.region

variables.name: VolumeId
variables.input:
smartscapeEdges "*"
| fieldsAdd source = toString(source_id), target = toString(target_id)
| filter startsWith(source, "AWS_EC2_VOLUME-")
| filter in(toString(target), array($SmartscapeId))
| fieldsKeep source

variables.name: AutoscalingGroup
variables.input:
smartscapeEdges "*"
| fieldsAdd source = toString(source_id), target = toString(target_id)
| filter startsWith(source, "AWS_AUTOSCALING_") OR startsWith(target, "AWS_AUTOSCALING_")
| filter in(toString(target), array($SmartscapeId))
| fieldsKeep source

variables.name: PrimaryTag
variables.input:
data record(name="ANY")
| append [
    fieldsSnapshot metrics
    | filter startsWith(field, "primary_tags.")
    | fieldsRename name = field
    | fields name
]
| dedup name

variables.name: PrimaryTagValues
variables.input:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| filter isNotNull($PrimaryTag:noquote)
| dedup $PrimaryTag:noquote
| fields $PrimaryTag:noquote
| sort $PrimaryTag:noquote

4.title: CPU utilization
4.query:
timeseries avg = avg(cloud.aws.ec2.CPUUtilization.By.InstanceId),
            by: {InstanceId, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| sort arrayAvg(avg) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

27.title: Instances per type
27.query:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($SmartscapeId))
| fieldsAdd aws.object
| parse aws.object, "JSON:json"
| fields instanceType = json[configuration][instanceType]
| filter isNotNull(instanceType)
| summarize  count=count(), by: {instanceType}
| sort count desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

29.content:
### AWS EC2

Instantly view the status of your EC2 environment at a glance. Dive into detailed insights for specific instances to monitor and predict anomalies, review state, health, and performance metrics for your EC2 Instances, EBS volumes, and Auto Scaling Groups.

Inspect the selected instances in the [Clouds App](/ui/intent/dynatrace.clouds/view_aws_service/#{"dt.timeframe":{"to":"$dt_timeframe_to","from":"$dt_timeframe_from"},"explorer.type":"vm","dt.smartscape.aws_ec2_instance":"$SmartscapeId"}).

---

30.title: Instances per region
30.query:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($SmartscapeId))
| summarize count=count(), by: {aws.region}
| sort count desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

31.title: Active EC2 instances
31.query:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($SmartscapeId))
| summarize count=countDistinct(id)

52.title: Total network input
52.description: The total number of bytes received by the instance on all network interfaces.
52.query:
timeseries  NetworkInput = sum(cloud.aws.ec2.NetworkIn.By.InstanceId),
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| fieldsAdd groupSum = arraySum(NetworkInput)
| summarize x = sum(groupSum)

53.title: Total network output
53.description: The total number of bytes sent out by the instance on all network interfaces.
53.query:
timeseries  NetworkOut = sum(cloud.aws.ec2.NetworkOut.By.InstanceId),
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| fieldsAdd groupSum = arraySum(NetworkOut)
| summarize x = sum(groupSum)

57.title: Network input
57.query:
timeseries in = sum(cloud.aws.ec2.NetworkIn.By.InstanceId),
            by: {InstanceId, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}

| sort arraySum(out) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

66.title: Read bytes
66.query:
timeseries x = sum(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeReadBytes.By.VolumeId),

78.content:
### AWS EBS
Monitor your block-storage service designed for EC2.

99.title: Instances with highest CPU usage
99.description: The most recent percentage of physical CPU time that Amazon EC2 uses to run the EC2 instance, which includes time spent to run both the user code and the Amazon EC2 code.
99.query:
timeseries max = max(cloud.aws.ec2.CPUUtilization.By.InstanceId), 
            by: {InstanceId, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| fieldsadd lastMaxCPU=toLong(arrayLast(max))
| fields InstanceId, lastMaxCPU
| sort lastMaxCPU desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

100.title: Volumes idle time
100.description:
The total number of seconds in a specified period of time when no read or write operations were submitted.
High idle time indicates underutilized resources like EBS volume attached to an EC2 instance that is not actively used.
100.query:
timeseries x = avg(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeIdleTime.By.VolumeId),
            by: {VolumeId, Name, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
                    AND in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($VolumeId)[])))}
| fieldsAdd VolumeIdleTime = arrayLast(x)
| sort VolumeIdleTime desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

101.title: Volumes queue length
101.description: The number of read and write operation requests waiting to be completed in a specified period of time.
101.query:
timeseries x = avg(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeQueueLength.By.VolumeId),
            by: {VolumeId, Name, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
                    AND in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($VolumeId)[]))) OR
                      matchesValue($VolumeId, "ALL")}
| fieldsAdd Length = arrayLast(x)
| sort Length desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

102.title: Burst balance percentage
102.description: Percentage of I/O credits (for gp2) or throughput credits (for st1 and sc1) remaining in the burst bucket.
102.query:
timeseries x = avg(cloud.aws.ebs.BurstBalance.By.VolumeId),
            by: {VolumeId, Name, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
                    AND in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($VolumeId)[]))) OR
                      matchesValue($VolumeId, "ALL")}
| fieldsAdd y = arrayAvg(x)
| limit toLong($Limit)

105.content:
### AWS Auto Scaling groups
Monitor the Auto Scaling groups that contain your fleet of EC2 instances.

106.title: Auto Scaling groups by group max size
106.query:
timeseries {max = max(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupMaxSize.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            min = max(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupMinSize.By.AutoScalingGroupName)},
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| fieldsAdd MaxSize = arrayLast(max), MinSize = arrayLast(min)
| sort MaxSize desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

107.title: Auto Scaling groups by desired capacity
107.description: The number of instances that the Auto Scaling groups attempt to maintain.
107.query:
timeseries cap = max(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupDesiredCapacity.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| fieldsAdd Capacity = arrayMax(cap)
| sort Capacity desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

108.title: In-service instances
108.description: The number of instances that are running as part of the Auto Scaling group.
108.query:
timeseries instances = avg(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupInServiceInstances.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| sort arrayAvg(instances) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

109.title: Pending instances
109.description: The number of instances that are pending. A pending instance is not yet in service.
109.query:
timeseries instances = avg(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupPendingInstances.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| fieldsAdd currentValue = arrayLast(instances)
| fieldsadd current_status = if(currentValue==0, "", else: "PENDING")
| limit toLong($Limit)

110.title: Standby instances
110.description: The number of instances that are in a Standby state. Instances in this state are still running but are not actively in service.
110.query:
timeseries instances = avg(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupStandbyInstances.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| sort arrayAvg(instances) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

111.title: Terminating instances
111.description: The number of instances that are in the process of terminating. This metric does not include instances that are in service, pending, or returning to a warm pool after Auto Scaling group scale in.
111.query:
timeseries instances = avg(cloud.aws.autoscaling.GroupTerminatingInstances.By.AutoScalingGroupName),
            by: {AutoScalingGroupName, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region))
                    AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($AutoscalingGroup)[])))}
| sort arrayAvg(instances) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

116.title: Status Check failures
116.query:
timeseries checkFailedCount=max(cloud.aws.ec2.StatusCheckFailed.By.InstanceId),
            by: {InstanceId, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| sort arraySum(checkFailedCount) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

117.title: CPU Credits Balance
117.query:
timeseries CPUCreditsBalance=avg(cloud.aws.ec2.CPUCreditBalance.By.InstanceId),
            by: {InstanceId, aws.account.id, aws.region, dt.smartscape_source.id},
            filter:{in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId)) AND
                    in(aws.region, array($Region)) AND
                    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))}
| sort arrayAvg(CPUCreditsBalance) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

122.content:
### Problems & Warnings
Problems and warning signals for your AWS EC2. [Investigate active problems](/ui/apps/dynatrace.davis.problems/).

123.title: Active Problems
123.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_ec2_instance")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| summarize count()

124.title: Active warning signals
124.query:
fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_ec2_instance")
| filter event.type == "WARNING"
| dedup event.id, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| summarize count()

125.title: Active problems details
125.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_ec2_instance")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, event.start
| fieldsRename id = display_id, problem = event.name, category = event.category, start = event.start
| sort category asc

126.title: Active warnings details
126.query:
fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_ec2_instance")
| filter event.type == "WARNING"
| dedup event.id, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fields event.name, event.category, event.start
| fieldsRename name = event.name, category = event.category, start = event.start
| sort category asc
